title: Strategic Doctrine Language Models (sdLM): A Learning-System Framework for Doctrinal Consistency and Geopolitical Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2601.14862v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Strategic Doctrine Language Models (sdLM), a learning-system framework for multi-document strategic reasoning with doctrinal consistency constraints and calibrated uncertainty. The approach combines multi-document attention, temporal encoding, and a doctrine-consistency layer to improve long-horizon forecasting and plan plausibility while reducing severe doctrinal violations. We evaluate sdLM using (i) expert-panel scoring of strategic scenarios (N=47), (ii) doctrine consistency on 336 doctrine publications (12,847 statements), and (iii) geopolitical forecasting on 127 historical counterfactuals (1945-2020) across 12-60 month horizons. Across these benchmarks, sdLM achieves higher strategic quality and better calibration than strong general-purpose LLM baselines, and remains competitive with human experts on long-horizon judgments. translated_title: 战略条令语言模型：一个面向条令一致性与地缘政治预测的学习系统框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了战略条令语言模型，这是一个面向多文档战略推理的学习系统框架，具备条令一致性约束和校准的不确定性。该方法结合了多文档注意力机制、时间编码和条令一致性层，以提升长程预测能力和计划合理性，同时减少严重的条令违规。我们通过以下三种方式评估sdLM：(i) 对战略情景进行专家小组评分（N=47）；(ii) 在336份条令出版物（12,847条陈述）上检验条令一致性；(iii) 在127个历史反事实案例（1945-2020年）上进行跨越12-60个月时间范围的地缘政治预测。在这些基准测试中，sdLM相比强大的通用大语言模型基线实现了更高的战略质量和更好的校准性，并且在长程判断方面与人类专家保持竞争力。我们还进一步报告了消融实验、扩展趋势以及面向部署的性能/延迟表现。
tldr: 提出了战略条令语言模型框架，通过融合多文档注意力、时间编码和条令一致性层，在多文档战略推理中实现条令一致性与校准不确定性，其战略质量和长程地缘政治预测能力超越通用大语言模型基线，并可与人类专家媲美。
en_tdlr: sdLM is a learning-system framework combining multi-document attention, temporal encoding, and a doctrine-consistency layer, achieving superior strategic reasoning quality and calibrated long-horizon geopolitical forecasting that outperforms general-purpose LLM baselines and remains competitive with human experts.
